deliverables.title: Device-card schema: CTT card, shared-digital-chiplet card, named empty ReRAM/MRAM slots
deliverables.report: config.py gained CIMAnalogCardConfig / CIMDigitalChipletCardConfig / CIMCardLibrary / CIMCardValidityPoint under an optional cim.cards block; cim.analog and cim.fabric are the cards' parameter halves, so an absent block synthesizes cards wrapping those very objects with every knob inert. Knobs: bits_per_cell/weight_bits (slicing present iff bits_per_cell < weight_bits), slicing arrangement, bank_depth (allocation granularity in mux slots), stack_3d_height (footprint divisor only), bank_switch_cycles, a validity menu that refuses unlisted points (cim_timing.CardValidityError), and pool cost knobs defaulting to 0; the digital card's energy_per_op_pj was REMOVED (audit fix) because no law prices a fabric op's energy, so declaring it is now a named refusal rather than an inert knob that reads as active, while its area_mm2 is reported through shared_digital_area_mm2 / system_area_mm2 and never smeared into the analog parity total (D21). reram/mram stay named empty slots that refuse to inherit (ADJ-4), and WAVE D added device: custom - the explicit escape hatch for a device this tool ships no numbers for, admitted by name and required to supply a complete params block, so an unlisted family is still refused and a typo can never become a device. ASSUMPTIONS: CimDeviceModel binds self.analog/self.fabric to the ACTIVE card, object-identical for every shipped YAML, so numbers are bit-identical; CIMConfig.analog_card / digital_card on a hand-built config (cards=None) now raise the named MissingCardLibraryError instead of a NoneType AttributeError.

deliverables.title: Tile object, enumerator, capacity/validity checks, banking allocation config
deliverables.report: cim_timing.py gained TileOwner / TileSite / Tile plus CimDeviceModel.enumerate_tiles, tile_macro_count, macro_occupancy, validate_macro_capacity and allocation_sites/validate_allocation; a column set is one mux slot (cols_adc stored columns, one ADC pass) and the smallest allocatable unit (ADJ-4), and at the shipped defaults the enumerator returns exactly arrays(K,N) tiles on arrays(K,N) macros, so the census law IS the enumerator. Overflow, out-of-range and doubly-claimed column sets raise the named MacroCapacityError, and a user-written cim.allocation is capacity-checked while the hardware YAML is PARSED (audit fix: the check existed but ran only from tests). The optional cim.allocation block carries column_sets_per_tile plus explicit owner-named assignments; ABSENT reproduces dedicated-per-matrix behavior bit-identically (tested). WAVE D: assignments[].slice_index parsed and was then dropped on the floor - it now defaults to None (unconstrained, never a claim of slice 0) and, when DECLARED, is checked against the tile declaration order actually places it on, with a mismatch refused by name in fws_mapping._apply_user_allocation.

deliverables.title: Active-column-set pricing law + full-occupancy identity test (ADJ-4); parity suites stay green
deliverables.report: CimDeviceModel.analog_op_time / active_column_sets / price_tiled_op price an op at M_tokens * active_column_sets * slice_cycles / f_analog, charging the worst macro, grouped exactly as vec_latency_s is so the full-occupancy identity is BIT-identical at every token count. Bank switching is a DECLARED card figure (bank_switch_cycles) charged (active - 1) times per op, and 0 is the shipped default for every card, so no number moves and the zero is disclosed rather than silent. ASSUMPTION: the parity configurations are not physically full-occupancy everywhere -- the MoE router (N = 16 against cols_adc 256) is the one shipped stage whose own N does not span mux column sets, and the test now asserts that physical statement instead of the dedicated-default tautology.

deliverables.title: Bit-slice composition (column-set + chained) with priced shift-add reduction descriptors
deliverables.report: n_slices = ceil(weight_bits / bits_per_cell) on the card; the column-set arrangement multiplies stored-column demand by n_s and keeps a slice group local to ONE macro - the enumerator places slice groups as units instead of packing tiles by linear index (audit fix: at n_s = 3 into 4 tile slots the groups straddled macros and the descriptors charged p2p transport for an arrangement defined never to need any) and refuses by name when a group cannot fit one macro. chained_macros gives each slice its own macros and sets transport_partials = n_s-1 for the p2p law. reduction_descriptors() emits plain-data ReductionOpDescriptor records (kind, arrangement, owner, operand tiles, output lanes, adds_per_output = n_s-1, depth = ceil(log2 n_s), sink macro, local flag) and price_reduction() prices them as cycles = depth + ceil(results/lanes) - 1 with adds = results*(n_s-1); nothing is wired into the closed-form spatial report (legacy-frozen). ASSUMPTION: pool energy/area knobs default to 0 so an undeclared cost reports zero instead of an invented number, and chained partial bytes are m*lanes*(n_s-1)*act_bytes with act_bytes supplied by the caller.

deliverables.title: Per-macro digital pool sizing, derived and reported
deliverables.report: digital_pool_sizing() derives lanes = ceil(cols_adc * f_analog / slice_cycles / f_pool) from the macro's peak result rate and lanes*(n_s-1) adders, with area from the card knob and macro_footprint_mm2() = area_mm2_per_array / stack_3d_height (height divides footprint only). The derived sizing is now actually REPORTED (audit fix: the deliverable was marked done against a title nothing satisfied): every device_class: fws_cim run prints report_digital_pool()'s '[FWS-CIM] per-macro digital pool (derived, D12)' line with lanes, adders, clock, consumed result rate and footprint share. ASSUMPTION: it goes to stdout, not into fws_cim_report.json or the results txt — those are the frozen closed-form accounting (ADJ-8) that the P6.2 byte-identity gate holds, and the pool constrains no number in them. POOL_DISCLOSURE_AREA_SHARE = 0.2 (ADJ-4): disclose_digital_pool() additionally prints a loud [NOTE] when the pool's derived area reaches a fifth of the served macro footprint and changes no number.

deliverables.title: Digital op laws: SSD / selective scan, delta rule + RG-LRU, short conv on the pool, sliding-window attention, MLA seam
deliverables.report: cim_timing.py carries the P2.6 law layer (ssm_recurrent_scan_work with Mamba-1 as its unchunked subset, ssd_chunked_scan_work, delta_rule_work with RG-LRU as a strict subset, short conv absorbed into digital_pool_sizing, sliding-window wrappers, the MLA seam) on a shared-chiplet card whose vector_lanes has NO default and refuses by name, with price_vector_work bounding every law at lanes x clock BY CONSTRUCTION; 76 tests in tests/test_qif_digital_ops.py, every law with a hand-computed point. WAVE B FIX: the single OPTIMA cross-check was stated at 1 GHz, but compiler_mamba_giant.yaml declares clock_GHz 0.8 and the scenario overrides only interconnect bandwidth - at the RECORDED point (reuse 256, T_L 32, T_N 8, L' 16, U 16) the tiling ceil is EXACTLY 1.0 and the port is exact with no residual (the old 520/512 = 1.015625 was an artifact of the wrong clock), and the beta factor is T_L = 32. ASSUMPTIONS: a vector lane retires ONE scalar op per cycle, so ops = muls + adds is one accounting; the chunked SSD and delta-rule laws charge the TAIL CHUNK FULL and are LAW_UNVALIDATED (no chunked reference exists anywhere), and their causal stances DELIBERATELY differ - SSD charges the dense Q^2 plus an explicit mask term, the delta rule the strict triangle via the UT transform - which both docstrings state. ASSUMPTION (was an escalation, now decided): the scan engine's lane count IS a declared design point - configs/hardware-config/fws_cim_granite_tiny.yaml ships vector_lanes: 1024 labelled 'DECLARED DESIGN POINT, not measured silicon and not an OPTIMA port', about 1/8 of the same chiplet's 7.8e12 FLOP/s systolic peak, with vector_clock_ghz / vector_pipeline_depth / state_bytes_per_cycle inheriting cim.fabric, and every SSD number scales inversely with it; standing ask only, Samyak's measured figure replaces the 1024 when it exists.
